units.title: Take turns together
units.proposed_outcome: Caregiver practises responsive back-and-forth communication.
units.original_activity_concept: Follow a child-led gesture or sound and respond in a familiar language.
units.proposed_check: Caregiver describes what they noticed and how they responded.
units.under3_variant: Caregiver interaction only; no child screen task or milestone score.

units.title: Talk about a picture
units.proposed_outcome: Child can express an idea about a familiar picture in a comfortable mode.
units.original_activity_concept: Caregiver and child discuss an original picture; pointing or gestures count.
units.proposed_check: Observe participation without ranking speech ability.
units.under3_variant: Caregiver names familiar things during ordinary interaction.

units.title: Match and sort
units.proposed_outcome: Child explores sameness and difference.
units.original_activity_concept: Sort educator-approved safe large objects by one visible feature.
units.proposed_check: Child explains or indicates a match.
units.under3_variant: Caregiver describes one object; no sorting demand for infants.

units.title: Count while playing
units.proposed_outcome: Child connects a small spoken number with a visible quantity when ready.
units.original_activity_concept: Count safe large objects during a caregiver-led game.
units.proposed_check: Try a new small group without a timed test.
units.under3_variant: Caregiver narrates quantities; no required counting performance.

units.title: Take a turn
units.proposed_outcome: Child practises waiting and choosing during shared play.
units.original_activity_concept: Use a simple cooperative turn-taking game without competition.
units.proposed_check: Notice whether the activity remains comfortable and enjoyable.
units.under3_variant: Caregiver follows the child’s timing and signals.

units.title: Tell what happened
units.proposed_outcome: Child communicates a simple event sequence when ready.
units.original_activity_concept: Arrange original picture cards and describe a story together.
units.proposed_check: Invite a retell using speech, gesture or pictures.
units.under3_variant: Caregiver narrates an everyday routine; no sequence test.

units.title: Notice and compare
units.proposed_outcome: Child explores shape, size or position through play.
units.original_activity_concept: Describe and compare two safe familiar objects with a caregiver.
units.proposed_check: Child shows a difference in their chosen mode.
units.under3_variant: Caregiver offers supervised exploration; no quiz.

units.title: Choose a favourite activity
units.proposed_outcome: Caregiver can repeat an enjoyable learning interaction.
units.original_activity_concept: Let the child choose an activity to repeat, adapt or stop.
units.proposed_check: Caregiver records an optional private note outside the app.
units.under3_variant: Caregiver card only; no independent device use.

units.title: Listen and make meaning
units.proposed_outcome: Learner identifies an event in a short familiar-language story.
units.original_activity_concept: Discuss an original or rights-cleared story, with audio/text/picture choices.
units.proposed_check: Ask one new meaning question in the learner’s comfortable language.

units.title: Connect symbols and sounds
units.proposed_outcome: Learner practises language-appropriate print/sound patterns at their starting level.
units.original_activity_concept: Use educator-selected familiar words; do not impose an English phonics sequence on Myanmar.
units.proposed_check: Try a different word or symbol pattern.

units.title: Read a short message
units.proposed_outcome: Learner finds explicitly stated information in a suitable text.
units.original_activity_concept: Read an age-respectful original classroom message.
units.proposed_check: Point to the evidence for an answer.

units.title: Say it, then write it
units.proposed_outcome: Learner communicates a short idea at their writing level.
units.original_activity_concept: Tell, draw or write an original sentence with educator support.
units.proposed_check: Explain how the picture or words convey the idea.

units.title: Make sense of quantities
units.proposed_outcome: Learner represents and compares quantities at their starting level.
units.original_activity_concept: Use objects or original pictures; extend to place value if ready.
units.proposed_check: Solve a similar task with different quantities.

units.title: Solve an everyday problem
units.proposed_outcome: Learner chooses an operation or representation to solve a suitable problem.
units.original_activity_concept: Discuss a fictional sharing or shopping example with no personal finances.
units.proposed_check: Show the reasoning, not just the answer.

units.title: Measure and organise
units.proposed_outcome: Learner compares measures or reads a simple data display.
units.original_activity_concept: Create a picture tally or compare classroom objects.
units.proposed_check: Interpret one new display or comparison.

units.title: Ask for learning help
units.proposed_outcome: Learner practises a locally reviewed Thai classroom phrase with first-language support.
units.original_activity_concept: Hear an approved human recording and role-play with a caregiver or teacher.
units.proposed_check: Use the phrase appropriately in a second fictional situation.

units.title: Read for evidence
units.proposed_outcome: Learner finds and connects information in an age-respectful text at their current level.
units.original_activity_concept: Compare short original information cards; provide simpler text without childish artwork.
units.proposed_check: Explain an answer using text evidence.

units.title: Reason with quantities
units.proposed_outcome: Learner practises arithmetic or proportional reasoning at an appropriate entry level.
units.original_activity_concept: Use fictional quantities; offer foundational and extending variants.
units.proposed_check: Explain a new example with changed values.

units.title: Read a table or chart
units.proposed_outcome: Learner interprets a suitable data display.
units.original_activity_concept: Discuss a fictional timetable or chart, with a non-reading entry option.
units.proposed_check: Identify what the data do and do not show.

units.title: Communicate a learning need
units.proposed_outcome: Learner practises explaining a school or learning question in reviewed Thai.
units.original_activity_concept: Use a bilingual script with optional role-play; no audio upload.
units.proposed_check: Choose an appropriate response in a different situation.

units.title: Check an online claim
units.proposed_outcome: Learner distinguishes an unsupported post from evidence.
units.original_activity_concept: Compare synthetic harmless information cards with clear provenance.
units.proposed_check: Name a useful checking step; no immigration-case judgment.

units.title: Plan a small project
units.proposed_outcome: Learner contributes to an achievable shared learning project.
units.original_activity_concept: Plan a fictional or safe supervised project with roles and materials.
units.proposed_check: Explain choices and adapt the plan after feedback.

units.title: Ask, listen and decide
units.proposed_outcome: Learner practises respectful questions and considering another view.
units.original_activity_concept: Facilitator-led role-play about a low-stakes everyday decision.
units.proposed_check: Reflect privately without disclosure of difficult personal experiences.

units.title: Choose a next learning step
units.proposed_outcome: Learner can discuss a next step with a trusted educator.
units.original_activity_concept: Create a private learning portfolio sample and list questions about continuing education.
units.proposed_check: Educator helps identify an appropriate next activity, not a certified grade.
